ayahs.2: those who demand full measure when they buy,
ayahs.3: but give short measure or weight when they sell.
ayahs.4: Do they not think they will be resurrected
ayahs.6: the Day all humanity will stand before the Rabb of all worlds?
ayahs.7: No—the wicked are bound for Sijjin, a sealed register in the depths of Hell.
ayahs.8: And what will make you realize what Sijjin is?
ayahs.9: A book already inscribed and sealed.
ayahs.10: Woe that Day to those who deny!
ayahs.11: Those who deny the Day of Reckoning.
ayahs.12: None deny it except every transgressing sinner.
ayahs.13: When Our revelations are recited, they say, 'Ancient fables!'
ayahs.14: No—their hearts are stained by what they used to commit.
ayahs.15: They will be veiled from their Rabb that Day,
ayahs.17: and be told, 'This is what you used to deny.'
ayahs.18: No—the virtuous are bound for 'Illiyyun, a sealed register in the highest Gardens.
ayahs.19: And what will make you realize what 'Illiyyun is?
ayahs.21: witnessed by those nearest to Allah.
ayahs.22: The virtuous will be in bliss,
ayahs.24: You will recognize delight glowing on their faces.
ayahs.25: They are given sealed, pure wine
ayahs.26: whose last sip smells of musk. Let whoever aspires to this strive for it.
ayahs.28: a spring from which those nearest to Allah drink.
ayahs.29: The wicked used to laugh at the believers,
ayahs.30: wink at one another when passing them,
ayahs.31: and boast about it when returning to their people.
ayahs.32: When they saw believers, they would say, 'These people are truly astray,'
ayahs.33: though they were not sent as guardians over them.
ayahs.34: That Day the believers will laugh at those who rejected the truth,
ayahs.36: They will be asked, 'Have those who rejected the truth not been repaid for what they used to do?'
